// poops from Jordy's slopkit (jordyidk), generated by tools/build_poops_payload.py.
// https://github.com/jordyidk/slopkit
// Uses the loader ARW and gated worker chain.
// Port edits: E1 remove exports; E2 remove fetchInto; E3 delegate stage5Body;
// E4 inject launchKexp; E5 update the dry-run summary.
// PORT BOUNDARY and E markers are used by upstream fidelity checks.

const int64 = globalThis.int64;
if (typeof int64 !== "function")
  throw new Error("int64 is missing from the page; src/utils/int64.js did not load");

// Supply the non-mutating sub32 used by poops.
if (!int64.prototype.sub32) {
  int64.prototype.sub32 = function (value) {
    const low = (this.low - value) >>> 0;
    const hi = (this.hi - (low > this.low ? 1 : 0)) >>> 0;
    return new int64(low, hi);
  };
}
